'''2007 Texas State Championship Matthew Ortiz DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Ortiz]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Target the Main Generator
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
